text:
SoFi Stadium wɔ Inglewood, California, kurow a wɔde bɛyɛɛ 1908 wɔ Los Angeles metropolitan area mu. Los Angeles ankasa wɔ hɔ firi 1781 sɛ El Pueblo de Nuestra Senora la Reina de los Angeles, na metro a ɛanchor no anya nkɔso bɛyɛ second-largest wɔ United States mu na ɛyɛ global entertainment capital.

Stadium no gyina roughly 4.8 km firi Los Angeles International Airport, wɔ former Hollywood Park Racetrack site no so, sɛ centerpiece of Hollywood Park mixed-use development no. Greater Los Angeles nso wɔ hɔ sɛ ɛbɛ hosting ceremonies ma 2028 Summer Olympics, SoFi Stadium ka venues a ɛwɔ afiase no mu.

Los Angeles ka strongest soccer markets mu wɔ United States. Mexican-American ne Latino population kɛse ma CONCACAF ne CONMEBOL fixtures nya near-home-crowd atmosphere, na Mexico routinely tɔn out Los Angeles area, sɛnea ɛkɔɔ so wɔ 2023 Gold Cup Final. Metro no wɔ MLS clubs two, LA Galaxy ne LAFC, na ɛkura deep history of high-profile international matches, first wɔ Rose Bowl na nnɛ wɔ SoFi Stadium.

Ɛfata sɛ yɛka sɛ football culture yi bɔɔ Los Angeles metro no nyinaa ho, ɛnyɛ Inglewood kurow ketewa a stadium no wɔ mu no. Metro no scale, ne Latino fan base a ɛwɔ passion, ne ne long pedigree of staging marquee international football ma ɛyɛ fitting host wɔ tournament map no mu.
